List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource

Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Decrease in the number of
classrooms
*81. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
SHRI K.E. ISMAIL:
 Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of classrooms in Government primary
schools has been decreasing in recent years
in certain States and Union Territories;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Literacy among muslim
families
†*82. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of such muslim families
in the country in which no family member
is literate;
(b) whether any survey etc. has been
done in this regard, if so, the details
thereof;
(c) the steps Government have taken
so far to make such families literate; and
(d) the number of illiterate muslim
families and the amount of money allotted
during the last five years, State-wise?
Modernization of Meteorological
Department
*83. SHRIMATI  SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of EARTH
SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plans to
modernize the country's Meteorological
Department to be able to provide agriculture
related weather information which is crucial
for optimal agricultural production, to
farmers in all the 600 districts in the
country;
(b) if so, whether the entire process will
take about five-six years;
(c) if so, whether the system needs to
be modernized and the basic structure will
be ready by 2008;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

29
(d) if so, the other plans for revamping
the Meteorological Department; and
(e) to what extent it will be more
modernized?
Upgradation of facilities in higher
education
*84. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Centre has written to
the States lagging in higher education with
a view to help them to upgrade these
facilities;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what is the status of Orissa in the
higher education survey that has been
conducted for the purpose; and
(d) what is the action plan of
Government to help Orissa in the matter?
New Mining Policy
*85. SHRI DHARAM PAL SABHAR-
WAL: Will the Minister of MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to put in place a New Mining
Policy;
(b) if so, the salient features of the
proposed policy;
(c) whether it is a fact that State
Governments are not granting mining lease
rights within the stipulated period; and
(d) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to make it mandatory for State
Governments to grant mining lease rights
within the stipulated period?
Vocational training
*86. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that our vocational
training lags far behind the rest of the world
and only 153 courses are recognised out of
2945 vocational courses offered round the
globe;
(b) if so, Government's response
thereto; and
(c) whether Government are seriously
considering to introduce career oriented new
specialized vocational courses for getting
more employment opportunities to the
youth in various parts of the country?
FDI in higher education
*87. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
permit FDI in higher education in the
country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of recognized Central,
State, State-aided, private and deemed
universities currently operating in the
country, State-wise;
(d) whether certain sections of the
academics are opposed to FDI in education
sector on the ground that private and
Government aided universities would not
be able to compete with foreign universities
operating in the country; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?

30
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Vacancies in schools
†*88. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that various
categories of posts are lying vacant in
Government schools, Kendriya Vidyalayas
and Navodaya Vidyalayas in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons behind these vacancies; and
(c) the details of Government's plan to
fill up the said vacancies?
Mines leased to National Mineral
Development Corporation

to state:
(a) the number of mines leased to

Proposal for oceanarium at
Kochi
571. SHRI THENNALA G.
BALAKRISHNA PILLAI: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to start an oceanarium at Kochi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government of Kerala has
submitted any proposal in this regard; and
(d) if so, the action taken by
Government in this regard?
Ocean and atmospheric science and
technology cells in the country
572. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of universities where ocean
and atmospheric science and technology cells
are available in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether his Ministry is supporting
ocean and atmospheric science and
capacity building programmes in the above
universities;
(c) what research projects the Indian
National Centre for Ocean Information
Services, Hyderabad have undertaken
during the last five years, year-wise; and
(d) the results thereof?
Areas affected by global warming
†573. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
SHRI VINAY KATIYAR:
Will the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES
be pleased to state:
(a) the areas in India which may be
adversely affected by global warming in
the coming few years;
(b) whether there are some areas which
may be submerged;
(c) whether there is a danger to the
industries being set up or already existing
at sea-shore on account of this; and
(d) whether in the light of above
possibilities, Government are providing
due information to the concerned area/
States; if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

135
Antarctic Campaign Programme
†574. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
EARTH SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Antarctic Campaign
Programme has been finalized;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the criteria for selection of members
of the team going to Antarctic;
(d) whether the team going to Antarctic
consists of scientists and technicians only;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
New warning system on impending
tsunami disasters
575. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that new warning
system about the impending tsunami
disasters would be in place by September,
2007;
(b) if so, whether this system will be
foolproof and the time-frame by when it will
trigger warnings;
(c) whether it will be prior to impending
disaster or after this and the modalities
adopted to take affected people to safer
places; and
(d) whether it will be placed at one place
and will relay the warning over the affected
areas and will the local authorities be active
within this response period?
Wastage of food items
†576. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI:
Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that on an average,
food items worth 13 billion dollars go waste/
unutilized annually;
(b) if not, the estimate of Government in
this regard;
(c) whether it is a fact that this loss can
be prevented having a food processing
system in place;
(d) if so, the details thereof and maximum
extent of the loss which can be prevented;
and
(e) the amount required for preventing
this maximum loss by setting up the
processing system?
Food processing units in Sikkim
577. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any scheme to set up food
processing industry in the State of
Sikkim;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of financial allocation
made by Government to set up food
processing units in Sikkim during the last
three years?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

136
Sanctioning of food processing
industries
578. SHRI MANOHAR JOSHI: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of food processing
industries sanctioned and money allocated
in the last two years;
(b) whether any industry has been
sanctioned for Maharashtra;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Increase in share of food processing
market

the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING

(a) whether in spite of India being
among major foodgrains producers in the
world, its share is less than even 1 per cent
in processed food market;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether the Agriculture Produce
